title: OpenReadingResponse

BBox.description: CANONICAL geometry: top-left origin, y increases downward, normalized to [0,1] relative to the containing page's width/height. This is the ONE convention the normalizer emits (see §6.1). Absolute coordinates are recoverable via page.width/page.height/page.unit. Raw source geometry is preserved in bbox_native.

polygon.description: Optional 4+ corner points, same normalized top-left space. Present when source gives a polygon (Textract, Azure, DocAI, unstructured, Marker/Surya).

bbox_native.description: Raw source geometry, untouched, for round-trip fidelity.

dpi.description: Set when unit=pixel and geometry is dpi-dependent (pytesseract, Mistral, rasterized OCR).

Block.description: One reading-order element. `type` is the normalized enum; `native_type` preserves the backend's own label.

type.description: Normalized down from each backend's own vocabulary; unmapped types → 'other' with native_type retained.

native_type.description: Backend's own label, verbatim: Textract 'KEY_VALUE_SET', unstructured 'NarrativeText', dots-ocr 'Section-header', Chunkr segment_type, Docling label.

text.description: Plain text of the element (assembled if the backend only gives sub-word units).

markdown.description: Per-element markdown/HTML when the backend renders it (Chunkr segment.content, Reducto block content, LlamaParse item.md, MinerU table_body HTML).

html.description: Table HTML when provided (unstructured text_as_html, Azure, MinerU, Marker, dots-ocr Table text).

confidence.description: Normalized to [0,1]. Textract 0-100 → /100. Absent for deterministic parsers (pymupdf/pdfplumber/pdfminer), markdown-only outputs, and token-stream LLMs (see §6.4).

reading_order.description: 0-based index in reading order when the backend establishes one.

rows.description: Lowest-common-denominator list-of-lists (pymupdf Table.extract(), pdfplumber, camelot). Nulls for empty cells.

children.description: Ids of child blocks when a hierarchy is preserved (Textract CHILD relationships, Docling groups, DocAI). Flattened output keeps this optional edge list; consumers who only want the flat list ignore it.

text_type.description: Textract TextType; Azure styles[].isHandwritten. Unknown for backends that don't distinguish.

output_paradigm.description: Which paradigm(s) the raw output was, before normalization. Lets consumers reason about what is native vs derived.

document.description: Doc-level results. At least one of {markdown, text, typed_fields, pages[].blocks} MUST be populated (see anyOf below) — that is the honest common denominator across P1..P6.

markdown.description: Full-document markdown export. Native for P1/P4; assembled from blocks for P3/P5; from tokens for P6; IMPOSSIBLE for pure P2 extractors with no text (Sensible) → absent.

text.description: Full-document plain text in reading order. Same availability as markdown.

description.description: e.g. Textract Lending PageType '1005', DocAI classifier label.

width.description: In page.unit; needed to de-normalize bbox.

unit.description: The unit width/height are in. Azure reports inch (PDF) or pixel (image); pdf libs report pdf_point; OCR reports pixel@dpi.

blocks.description: THE COMMON SPINE. Reading-order typed blocks. Empty [] for pure typed-field APIs and un-prompted token-stream LLMs (honest: not a failure, a structural absence).

confidence.description: Page-level confidence when the backend gives one (Mistral page granularity, Docling page confidence report, camelot per-table).

image_base64.description: Rendered page image when requested/returned (Chunkr pages[].image is a presigned URL → normalizer MAY inline or keep url).

source_backend.description: the backend that produced this page (page-granularity escalation).

typed_fields.description: Optional. Present for P2 extractors and P6 user-schema extraction. A map keyed by field name; each value normalized to a common Field shape. Absent for pure parsers (pymupdf, docling, unstructured, marker, OCR engines) — they extract structure, not fields.

value.description: string | number | boolean | null | nested object | array (Mindee SimpleField/ObjectField/ListField collapse into this).

normalized_value.description: Backend's normalized form where present (Textract AnalyzeID NormalizedValue, DocAI normalizedValue{dateValue,moneyValue}).

confidence.description: Numeric [0,1] where numeric (Chunkr/Reducto/DocAI); qualitative enum preserved as string where the backend is qualitative (Mindee Certain/High/Medium; Sensible confident_answer/...).

citations.description: Per-field source grounding (Reducto /extract citations, Chunkr Citation leaves, Claude page_location).

chunks.description: Optional. RAG chunks when requested and supported natively (Reducto chunks, Chunkr chunks, unstructured CompositeElement, LlamaIndex nodes, Docling chunker). Otherwise the router may derive from blocks.

usage.description: Normalized cost/usage. Fields are per-backend-natural; the router computes cost_usd via the pricing model, filling what the backend reports.

cost_usd.description: Router-computed cost-per-page-equivalent, or backend-billed cost. Null for local backends (infra cost modeled separately).

job.description: Async job handle when applicable (Textract JobId, LlamaParse pjb-..., Chunkr task_id, Reducto job_id).

warnings.description: Requested-but-unsupported outputs/features, degradations, coordinate-conversion notes. E.g. 'typed_fields requested but backend is a parser; empty', 'confidence unavailable for deterministic parser', 'bbox omitted: markdown-only tier'.

backend_raw.description: The untouched native payload (hosted JSON) or the serialized native object (library) — see §5. Present when outputs.include_backend_raw=true. This is the escape hatch that makes lossy normalization safe: nothing the backend produced is ever destroyed.

payload.description: The raw value, or a reference handle when too large to inline.

object_class.description: For serialized native objects: fully-qualified class, e.g. 'fitz.Page.get_text.dict', 'docling_core.types.doc.DoclingDocument', 'unstructured...Element'.

orchestration.description: Strategy execution trace (present only for strategy-engaged runs): strategy, config_hash, chosen_backend, fallback_depth, outcome, attempts[], decisions[], dropped[].

description: v0.2 adds the optional `orchestration` block (strategy execution trace) and `pages[].source_backend` (page-granularity provenance). Additive over v0.1: every v0.1 response remains valid.
